stage.name: Il Molise
stage.spawn_type: Tiled layout outside the screen; enemies cannot move, so the player must walk to make room for more to spawn
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox fields. Bonus stage, first one in the game; time limit 15:00. Hyper mode (+50% gold, +20% luck, x1.6 enemy health, x2 player speed) not needed. Enemy speed multiplier is irrelevant since enemies do not move.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Waves 0-14 keep both enemy minimum and maximum at 500 (spawn interval 0.1 s); from 15:00 the maximum drops (40 at 15, 30, 20, 15, 10, 10, 5 ...), and 21:00 goes to 250.
stage.spawn_rule: Enemies spawn only outside the screen in a tiled layout and never move; the player moving reveals free tiles for new spawns.

stage_items.bat_dragon: Bat Dragon appears 5-6 tilesets northeast of start only with the Green Eyes Vizard relic (out of scope).

stage.destructibles: Light sources (destructible chance 30%, max 60%, max 10 at once).
stage.notes: Wiki waves 16:00-22:00+ (Reaper each minute, gold pot farming, 21:00 Arcana Dead Molisano boss) are beyond the 15:00 limit and are not included as waves.

layout.size_note: Large open grassy field, effectively unbounded around the start, kept full of stationary enemies in a tiled grid.
layout.obstacles: None described; open map with flowers and grass, no walls. The density of enemies (up to 500 immobile ones) acts as the obstacle field.
layout.theme: Bright unspoilt Italian countryside meadow with singing flowers (music: Vempair Survaivors, a Funiculi Funicula remix); joke stage about the region of Molise.
layout.special_mechanics: Enemies don't move. ALL Molisano enemies (Sad/Happy/Cute/Old/Dead Molisano and variants: Base, Secco, Bello, Fagiolo, Grosso, Giallo, Rosso, Colonna, Vecchio) and the Molisano Anfora gold pots have MoveSpeed 0; they only deal damage (power 1) when the player touches them. Enemies are placed outside the screen in a tiled layout, so the player must move to make room for more spawns; 500 alive is the target for minutes 0-14. Exceptions: The Reaper (from 15:00) moves and is lethal; the Bat Dragon (only with the Green Eyes Vizard relic) is a separate roaming enemy. O'Sole Meeo takes no damage from Molisano enemies; Celestial Dusting gives them extra health. Molisano Grosso wiki text says only 'cannot move'. Anforas drop a Gold Coin instead of XP. At 15:00 all previous enemies are erased and only sparse gold pots spawn alongside the Reaper. Freeze/Orologion mainly prevents touch damage.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 15:00 on this bonus stage (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
